verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a startup formation and back-office platform, so a document e-signature workflow is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions sending documents for legally binding e-signature, multiple recipients, or signing order. The cited material covers only registered agent, mailroom, banking access, accounting, tax and Carta cap-table integration, none of which is e-signature.

support.subject: As a founder, I can send a document for legally binding e-signature to multiple recipients with routing
